pasos: (async () => { const s = (t, x, y) => document.querySelector('#plato canvas').dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent(t, { bubbles: true, clientX: x, clientY: y, pointerId: 7, button: 0, pointerType: 'mouse' })); const r = document.querySelector('.solar[data-id="calculo"]').getBoundingClientRect(), c = window.__clavija(); s('pointerdown', c[0], c[1]); for (let k = 1; k <= 12; k++) { s('pointermove', c[0] + (r.x + r.width / 2 - c[0]) * k / 12, c[1] + (r.y + r.height * 0.4 - c[1]) * k / 12); await new Promise((ok) => setTimeout(ok, 30)); } s('pointerup', r.x + r.width / 2, r.y + r.height * 0.4); })()

nombre: arrastrar la clavija y soltarla en el aire
pasos: (async () => { const s = (t, x, y) => document.querySelector('#plato canvas').dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent(t, { bubbles: true, clientX: x, clientY: y, pointerId: 7, button: 0, pointerType: 'mouse' })); const c = window.__clavija(); s('pointerdown', c[0], c[1]); for (let k = 1; k <= 10; k++) { s('pointermove', c[0], c[1] - 30 * k); await new Promise((ok) => setTimeout(ok, 30)); } s('pointerup', c[0], c[1] - 300); })()
